items.exampleEn: Visiting hours in the children's ward end at eight.
items.exampleZh: 兒童病房的探病時間到八點。

items.exampleEn: This tablet has a bigger screen than my phone.
items.exampleZh: 這台平板的螢幕比我的手機大。

items.exampleEn: Car insurance is expensive for young drivers.
items.exampleZh: 年輕駕駛的汽車保險很貴。

items.exampleEn: She is a specialist in old furniture.
items.exampleZh: 她是老家具方面的專家。

items.exampleEn: Ambulances can drive through red lights.
My cousin works as a vet in the countryside.

items.sentenceEn: Did you remember to buy travel insurance?
items.sentenceZh: 你記得買旅遊保險了嗎？

items.audioEn: The vet's office is closed on Sunday, but you can call this number if your pet is sick.
items.audioZh: 動物醫院星期天休息，但寵物生病的話可以打這支電話。
items.questionZh: 寵物生病而動物醫院休息時，可以怎麼做？

items.sentenceEn: The specialist will see you at ten.
items.sentenceZh: 專科醫師十點會幫你看診。

items.sentenceEn: An ambulance came quickly after the accident.
items.sentenceZh: 事故發生後，救護車很快就來了。

items.stemEn: Her ____ pays for a hospital stay.
items.stemZh: 她的保險會支付住院的費用。

items.stemEn: Mr. Kato is a heart ____ at the city hospital.
items.stemZh: Kato 先生是市立醫院的心臟專科醫師。

items.passageEn: To all staff: Starting next month, our company will offer new health insurance. It pays for hospital stays, visits to a specialist, and the cost of an ambulance. It also pays for treatment for injuries at work. If you stay in a hospital ward, you will not have to pay. Pets are not included, so please continue to pay your own vet bills. For questions, use the form on your tablet or call Mr. Kato's office.
items.passageZh: 全體員工請注意：從下個月起，公司將提供新的健康保險。保險支付住院、看專科醫師以及救護車的費用，也支付工作受傷的治療費用。如果住在醫院病房，你不需要付錢。寵物不在保險範圍內，所以獸醫的帳單請繼續自行支付。有問題請用平板上的表單，或打電話到 Kato 先生的辦公室。

options: 請專科醫師看診的費用

referenceEn: My dog is sick, so I have to take it to the vet.
My dog is ill, and I need to take it to the vet.
rubricZh: vet 表示「獸醫」，例如 take … to the vet 等說法
動物可用 it 指稱

referenceEn: My tablet has no battery left.
rubricZh: 用 tablet 表示「平板電腦」
